name: standard_gamma_grad
description: Representative upstream schema: aten::_standard_gamma_grad(Tensor self, Tensor output) -> Tensor. The artifact maps to the private canonical base _standard_gamma_grad and computes the reparameterized Gamma gradient without mutating or aliasing either input. Tests cover the general, small-output, large-alpha near-mode and away-from-mode numerical branches, supported floating dtypes, noncontiguous inputs, input preservation, and invalid dtype or shape combinations.
